offers_products.reason: Sells connectivity service; equipment like routers is incidental to internet, TV and phone subscriptions.

offers_services.reason: Provides broadband internet, cable/streaming TV and home phone service, with installation and support.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Residential households buy internet, TV and phone plans; Glo Fiber and Flex Prepaid target homes.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Offers business services via shentelbusiness.com, though residential is the larger part.

recurring_revenue.reason: Monthly subscription billing for internet, TV and phone service.

cyclical_demand.reason: Home internet, TV and phone are essential monthly utilities-like services, rarely cut in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Monthly internet, TV and phone bills are small and frequent.

people_delivered.reason: Value is the network delivering internet and TV, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are households and small local businesses, not large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates fiber and cable broadband networks needing continual construction and upgrades across VA, WV, KY, MD.

notes: Business services are secondary to residential broadband; company recognized as regional broadband provider (Glo Fiber brand).
